name: Laekna, Inc.
summary: Laekna, Inc., an investing holding company, engages in the discovering, development, and commercialization of therapies for patients with cancer, metabolic diseases, and liver fibrosis worldwide. The company offers LAE002, an adenosine triphosphate competitive AKT inhibitor for the treatment of ovarian cancer, prostate cancer, and breast cancer; LAE001, an androgen synthesis inhibitor that inhibits CYP17A1 and CYP11B2 to treat prostate cancer; LAE005, a ligand-blocking humanized anti-PD-L1 IgG4 antibody for the treatment of triple-negative breast cancer; and LAE102, a monoclonal antibody against ActRIIA to treat obesity.
